opening.argument: The speaker presents Ludo-based earning as quick and accessible, claiming he earned a thousand rupees every three hours and that viewers need only try an application to earn several thousand rupees. He then urges viewers to try an endorsed app through the description link, where an installation request uses his referral code. These are direct earning claims tied to a call to participate, not merely a discussion of which apps may be fraudulent. His warnings about other apps do not qualify the unusually easy cash claims he makes for the apps he recommends.
